sentences.text:
And  In the matter of : Debomita Chakraborty @ Debosmita  Chakraborty  ....
 Mr. Anshunath Chakraborty,
 Mr. Gourab Mukhopadhyay  ....For the Petitioner.

Mr. Soumik Ganguly,
 Ms. Debadrita Mondal  ... For the State.
 1.
Heard the learned Counsel for the parties.

2. Considering the materials available in the case diary, the nature and extent of complicity of the petitioner in the commission of the alleged offence and having regard to the agreement for sale in which the husband of the petitioner was named as a vendor and no complicity of the petitioner could be established from the case diary, we are of the view that custodial interrogation of the petitioner is not necessary.

3. Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest, the petitioner namely, Debomita Chakraborty @
Debosmita Chakraborty, shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.5,000/-, with two Debomita Chakraborty @ Debosmita vs Unknown on 7 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/57731016/
1 registered sureties of like amount each, to the satisfaction of the arresting officer and also subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C., 1973 Signed By :
GURUPADA CHAKRABARTY High Court of Calcutta 8 th of October 2024 02:21:31 PM corresponding to Section 482(2) of the BNSS, 2023.

sentences.text: The petitioner shall meet the I.O. following the norms applicable to the female accused till the submission of the final report.

4. It is further directed that the petitioner shall appear before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Howrah in connection with G.R. Case No.3800 of 2024 within two weeks from date.
5. Accordingly, the application for anticipatory bail is disposed of.
6. All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.

(Soumen Sen, J.) (Uday Kumar, J.) Signed By :
